organization.name: McCluster Corp
organization.positioning: Technology, education, civic, media and creative operating organization.

product_model.statement: McCluster Corp is one operating organization with several distinct public, member and operator surfaces. The surfaces have different jobs but should agree on canonical entities, campaigns, evidence and outcomes.

layers.name: Identity, evidence and public record
layers.role: Explain who and what the organization is, expose verifiable claims, and give search engines, recruiters, media and software agents stable canonical entities.

layers.name: McCluster Platform and Control
layers.role: Shared technical and operator layer for accounts, data, APIs, analytics, releases, campaigns and internal operations.

layers.name: Equity Uprise
layers.role: Public-interest program layer for research, civic education, campaigns, culture and community action.

layers.name: Uprise Action Network
layers.role: Action-first member product where campaigns become missions and members can join, act, submit proof, be reviewed and build a verified action record.

layers.name: PRIM3
layers.role: Technology and cybersecurity learning product using the PRIM Method: Principles, Rhythm, Immersion and Missions.

layers.name: Studio, services and media
layers.role: Commercial web, social, photography, video, music, licensing and creative-direction work that funds and demonstrates the same production capabilities.

loops.name: Claim → evidence → canonical entity → public page → machine-readable record
loops.purpose: Keep public claims attributable, consistent and verifiable.

loops.name: Understand → Choose → Act → Prove → Verify → Progress → Collaborate
loops.purpose: Turn attention into completed, reviewable action instead of likes or passive engagement.

loops.name: Create → publish → receive participation → review proof → verify outcome → measure
loops.purpose: Keep campaign and member operations inside one operator plane rather than manual side channels.

principles: One canonical public identity graph for Matthew McCluster, McCluster Corp and the products it actually operates.
Evidence before claims: public-record pages and answer-engine data should point back to a document, primary source, public source code or clearly labeled first-party source.
The Action Network rewards useful, completed, verifiable action rather than likes, views, outrage or political viewpoint.
Action Network is the user-facing social-product identity; older implementation naming is a compatibility detail, not a public brand.
Control is the operator plane. Public/member surfaces should not require the owner to manually reconcile counts, proofs or campaign state outside the product.
Music and media are not detached side projects: they can be discovery, storytelling and campaign entry points, while retaining their own catalogue and rights records.
boundaries: Whip Equipped LLC is a separate company connected through Matthew McCluster's ownership/founding; it is not a McCluster Corp sub-brand.

Two properties, two entities: https://mccluster.org/ is McCluster Corp's property and the Organization's url; https://matthew.mccluster.org/ is Matthew McCluster's. Company product pages hosted on Matthew's property, this product map among them, keep their URLs for compatibility (data/seo/domain-architecture.json).
A public page may explain a product relationship without turning internal, unverified or private context into a public factual claim.
Payments are a platform capability; the primary Action Network participation loop is missions, proof and verification.
